Job Description: Telesales Team Leader

Company: TruckMitr Corporate Services Pvt. Ltd. Department: Telesales & Revenue Experience: Minimum 5 Years Team Size: Up to 20 Telesales Executives Job Location: Noida, Sector 65, Uttar Pradesh Employment Type: Full-Time | On-site

About TruckMitr

TruckMitr is a technology-driven platform transforming India's trucking and logistics ecosystem. We connect drivers, transporters, fleet owners, and other stakeholders through digital solutions that simplify driver hiring, verification, and logistics-related services.

We are looking for an experienced, mature, and target-driven Telesales Team Leader who can lead a team of up to 20 telesales executives, drive revenue growth, improve conversions, and take complete ownership of the team's performance against business targets.

Key Responsibilities

1. Team Leadership & Revenue Ownership

Lead, manage, and motivate a team of up to 20 telesales executives to achieve and exceed monthly revenue targets.

Take end-to-end ownership of the telesales department's revenue, productivity, and performance.

Be the single point of accountability for achieving company-assigned telesales targets.

Translate business goals into daily, weekly, and monthly targets for individual team members.

Develop actionable strategies to improve sales performance, conversion rates, and revenue per agent.

Proactively identify performance gaps and implement corrective actions.

2. Hands-on Sales & Deal Closure

Be an effective telesales professional who can personally handle important prospects and close challenging deals.

Step in when team members struggle to convert prospects, understand objections, or close sales.

Demonstrate effective sales pitches, objection handling, negotiation, and closing techniques.

Coach team members through live call support, call reviews, and practical demonstrations.

Support high-value prospects and critical sales opportunities whenever required.

3. Calling Metrics & Performance Monitoring

Understand and monitor key telesales performance metrics, including:

o

Daily calls and connected calls per agent.

o

Average Call Duration / Average Handling Time (ACD/AHT).

o

Lead-to-call and call-to-conversion ratios.

o

Follow-up efficiency and lead conversion rate.

o

Revenue per agent and overall team revenue.

o

Target achievement, productivity, and agent-wise performance.

Analyse calling reports, CRM dashboards, and performance data to identify bottlenecks.

Ensure that calling activity translates into meaningful customer conversations, conversions, and revenue.

4. Discipline, Productivity & Team Management

Maintain strict discipline, punctuality, attendance, calling schedules, and CRM reporting.

Ensure agents follow the prescribed calling process, scripts, lead allocation rules, and follow-up timelines.

Conduct daily team briefings, performance reviews, and regular coaching sessions.

Set clear expectations and hold team members accountable for their assigned targets.

Address underperformance through structured improvement plans, coaching, and appropriate escalation.

Build a competitive, motivated, and performance-oriented team culture.

5. Incentives, Targets & Performance Accountability

Understand and implement the company's sales targets, incentive structures, and performance policies.

Explain targets, incentive eligibility, and applicable performance-related penalties or consequences clearly to the team.

Monitor incentive eligibility and ensure performance calculations are supported by accurate data.

Identify high performers and develop strategies to improve the productivity of low-performing agents.

Submit accurate daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports to management.

6. Process Improvement & Coordination

Work closely with management, marketing, CRM, and operations teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.

Identify recurring customer objections and recommend improvements in sales pitches, pricing communication, and follow-up strategies.

Ensure proper use of CRM and calling systems for lead tracking, follow-ups, and revenue reporting.

Recruit, onboard, train, and develop telesales executives in coordination with HR, as required.

Recommend process improvements to make the telesales function more efficient, scalable, and revenue-focused.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

**Minimum 3 years of experience in telesales, with substantial experience leading and managing a telesales team.**

Proven experience managing a sizeable team, preferably 35–40 agents or more.

Demonstrated ability to achieve revenue targets and improve team conversion rates.

Strong understanding of telesales KPIs, calling matrices, CRM systems, lead management, and sales reporting.

Excellent communication, negotiation, objection-handling, and deal-closing skills.

Strong leadership, decision-making, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.

Proficiency in MS Excel/Google Sheets and CRM or dialer platforms.

Experience in B2B sales, subscription-based products, or technology-enabled services will be an advantage.

Essential Personal Attributes

Mature, responsible, disciplined, and professionally committed.

Strong ownership mindset with the ability to take responsibility for both results and corrective actions.

A hands-on leader who can lead by example rather than merely monitor the team.

Firm but fair in managing people, enforcing processes, and addressing underperformance.

Confident decision-maker who can work independently and respond quickly to business challenges.

Results-oriented, resilient, and comfortable working in a target-driven environment.

Able to motivate the team while maintaining high standards of productivity and accountability.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

**The selected candidate will be evaluated on:**

-Achievement of monthly and quarterly revenue targets.

-Team-wise and agent-wise target achievement.

-Call productivity and effective customer-connect rates.

-Lead-to-sale conversion rate.

-Revenue generated per agent.

-Improvement in underperforming agents' productivity.

-Team discipline, attendance, and process compliance.

-Accuracy and timeliness of performance reporting.

-Team coaching effectiveness and sustained sales performance.

What We Expect from the Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a sales leader who can deliver results, not just manage people. The ideal candidate must be capable of understanding the business numbers, building an effective sales strategy, coaching agents, handling difficult customer conversations, and personally closing deals when necessary.

The candidate will be the primary owner of telesales performance and must be prepared to answer for the department's results while proactively driving the actions needed to achieve company targets.

**About Genhealth and how we buy**

Genhealth runs a membership-based chronic-care pharmacy across Delhi NCR from one Noida hub and three pharmacy clusters. Members, mostly families managing diabetes, heart conditions, thyroid, PCOS and infertility.

Purchasing here is different from a typical retail pharmacy in four ways:

* **Just-in-time, zero stock.** We buy against confirmed customer orders, not for shelves. Speed and accuracy of sourcing decide whether the order goes out on the day.
* **Margin is made on the buy side.** The member discounts are high so there is pressure on purchase margins to make profit.
* **Wide range, low volumes per line.** Around 4,000 items a quarter, from branded ethicals and generics to cold-chain insulins, GLP-1 pens, transplant drugs and surgicals.
* **Institutional commitments.** We also have various partnerships, so buying below those commitments is essential.

**Purpose of the role**

To source every confirmed order in full and on time, from verified suppliers, at a landing cost that protects Genhealth's margin. The role owns three outcomes: the order is fulfilled, the rate is right, and the supply is genuine.

Key responsibilities

**1. Daily order sourcing**

* Pick up confirmed orders from the order desk through the day and place purchases the same day, in time for the 10:30 AM and 2:00 PM dispatch cycles.
* Find substitute suppliers quickly when a line is short. Never substitute the product itself without pharmacist approval.
* Keep the order desk informed of any sourcing issues so that the customer is informed before dispatch.

**2. Rates and negotiation**

* Get net rates after scheme from at least two suppliers on high-value and high-volume lines, and record them.
* Negotiate credit terms separately from rates.
* Run periodic rate enquiries on the top items and surgical lines, and compare quotes with current landing costs.
* Flag every item that sells below cost or below the margin floor, such as low-margin transplant and diabetes lines, to the COO before buying.
* Prepare bulk-buy proposals where a better rate justifies holding stock, with shelf-life of at least 18 months and the cash needed clearly stated.

**3. Supplier management and verification**

* Maintain an approved supplier list with drug licence, GST number, authorised companies, contact person, credit terms and rating.
* Buy only on a GST invoice showing batch and expiry. Never pay in advance to a new supplier.
* Treat an unusually low quote on GLP-1 pens, insulins, oncology drugs or albumin as a warning sign, and verify the source before buying.
* Go to the company or its authorised stockist first for oncology, transplant and other specialty drugs.
* Track supplier performance: fill rate, delivery time, billing accuracy, short supply and complaints.

**4. Cold-chain and specialty items**

* Collect and transport insulins, GLP-1 pens and other cold-chain items in validated cold boxes, and record temperature on receipt.
* Check expiry and batch on every cold-chain unit before it enters the hub.

**5. Goods receipt, records and ERP**

* Check every purchase against the invoice for quantity, batch, expiry, MRP and rate before entry.
* Enter purchases in the ERP the same day and keep the item master correct: MRP, pack size, category, GST rate.
* Report MRP or master-data mismatches between the purchase, sales and wholesale modules to the COO.
* Process purchase returns and expiry claims with suppliers and follow up credit notes to closure.
* Share purchase data with accounts for payment schedules and reconciliation.

**6. Own-brand and partnership supply**

* Coordinate supply of the GenLife / Generix own-brand range for retail, wholesale and online marketplace orders.
* Ensure partnership orders are sourced within the agreed turnaround and discount.

**7. Compliance**

* Follow the Drugs and Cosmetics Act for purchase of Schedule H, H1 and X drugs, and keep purchase records ready for inspection.
* Work with the Pharmacist-in-Charge on any controlled or prescription-only purchase.

title: Senior Executive – Supply Chain, Warehouse & Logistics
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Senior Executive – Supply Chain, Warehouse & Logistics to manage inventory, warehouse operations, procurement coordination, order fulfilment, dispatches, and transportation activities. The role involves ensuring the timely movement of products, maintaining accurate inventory records, coordinating with vendors and logistics partners, and supporting seamless delivery of company products.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in supply chain coordination, warehouse management, inventory control, and logistics operations, preferably in the IT hardware, electronics, AV equipment, or EdTech industry.

**Key Responsibilities**  
1. Supply Chain & Order Coordination

* Coordinate with procurement, sales, project, and finance teams to ensure timely availability and delivery of products.
* Track customer orders from order confirmation to dispatch and final delivery.
* Coordinate with suppliers and vendors regarding product availability, delivery schedules, pending orders, and documentation.
* Monitor supply chain activities and identify potential delays or operational bottlenecks.
* Maintain records of purchase orders, delivery schedules, goods receipts, and order fulfilment status.

2. Warehouse & Inventory Management

* Manage day-to-day warehouse operations, including receiving, inspection, storage, picking, packing, and dispatch of goods.
* Maintain accurate stock records for IFPDs, IT hardware, AV equipment, accessories, and other inventory.
* Ensure proper inward and outward stock entries and timely updating of inventory records in the ERP/system.
* Conduct periodic physical stock verification and reconcile discrepancies with system records.
* Monitor stock availability, ageing inventory, damaged goods, and slow-moving items.
* Ensure appropriate storage, product identification, labelling, and safe handling of electronic equipment.
* Coordinate the documentation and movement of goods between warehouse, office, vendor, and customer locations.

3. Logistics & Dispatch Management

* Coordinate with transporters, courier companies, and third-party logistics partners for timely deliveries and pickups.
* Arrange transportation based on delivery timelines, shipment size, product handling requirements, and cost considerations.
* Prepare and verify delivery challans, invoices, e-way bills, packing lists, LR/GR documents, and other applicable dispatch documentation.
* Track shipments and proactively follow up on delays, delivery exceptions, and proof of delivery.
* Ensure products are packed securely to prevent transit damage, particularly for display panels and electronic equipment.
* Coordinate reverse logistics, product returns, replacements, and movement of damaged or defective goods.
* Maintain records of freight charges, transportation expenses, and delivery performance.

4. Documentation & Reporting

* Maintain accurate records of inventory, stock transfers, goods received, dispatches, and deliveries.
* Prepare regular reports on stock position, pending dispatches, inventory discrepancies, and logistics status.
* Ensure proper documentation and traceability of all inward and outward material movements.
* Coordinate with the accounts and finance teams for invoice verification, freight bills, and vendor-related documentation.
* Support internal audits and ensure adherence to company policies and operational procedures.

5. Process Improvement & Coordination

* Identify opportunities to improve warehouse efficiency, inventory accuracy, dispatch turnaround time, and logistics costs.
* Follow established processes for inventory control, material handling, and warehouse safety.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to resolve supply chain and delivery-related issues.
* Ensure timely closure of operational queries and maintain effective communication with vendors, transporters, and internal teams.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations, Commerce, or a related discipline. A relevant diploma may also be considered.
* **4–6 years of hands-on experience** in supply chain coordination, warehouse management, inventory control, logistics, or order fulfilment.
* Practical experience managing warehouse inward/outward operations, stock reconciliation, and dispatch coordination.
* Experience coordinating with vendors, transporters, courier partners, and internal business teams.
* Working knowledge of inventory management systems, ERP software, and MS Excel.
* Understanding of GST invoices, e-way bills, delivery challans, and transportation documentation.
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, follow-up discipline, and problem-solving ability.
* Ability to manage multiple shipments, orders, and operational priorities simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in IT hardware, electronics, Interactive Flat Panel Displays (IFPDs), AV equipment, commercial displays, or EdTech products.
* Experience handling high-value, fragile, or bulky electronic equipment.
* Familiarity with ERP platforms such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or similar systems.
* Knowledge of inventory ageing, stock reconciliation, freight cost control, and reverse logistics.
* Experience coordinating multi-location deliveries and project-based dispatches.

Key Skills

* Supply Chain Coordination
* Warehouse & Inventory Management
* Logistics & Transportation Coordination
* Order Fulfilment & Dispatch Planning
* Vendor & Transporter Management
* Stock Reconciliation & Reporting
* ERP / Inventory Management Systems
* MS Excel & Documentation
* Problem-Solving & Cross-Functional Coordination

* Partner with stakeholders to identify growth opportunities and remove barriers to adoption.

* Monitor competitor activity, market trends, regulatory developments, and customer needs.
* Gather and communicate market intelligence to support product development and strategic decision\-making.
* Identify emerging opportunities related to international mobility, graduate employability, higher education admissions, and workforce skills.

* Prepare accurate sales forecasts, budgets, and business plans.
* Maintain opportunity and customer data within Salesforce and other reporting tools.
* Track performance against agreed KPIs and recommend corrective actions where required.
* Produce regular business reviews and growth reports for leadership teams.

* Deliver effective assessment product training to internal teams, partners, and customers.
* Work closely with sales, marketing, customer success, and operations teams to ensure successful implementation of growth initiatives.

**Impact of the Role**



This role is critical to expanding Oxford English Assessment across India and establishing the Oxford Test of English as a preferred English proficiency assessment. **Location:** Noida  
**Working Days:** 6 Days a Week  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years  
**Qualification:** B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering – Mandatory  
**MBA Marketing:** An advantage

THE ROLE

We are looking for a self\-driven Sales Engineer to handle the sale of gas odorisation systems and engineered skid solutions to end customers across India.

The role covers the complete sales cycle, including generating enquiries, preparing techno\-commercial offers, bidding, negotiating, and closing orders.

The candidate should be capable of developing new accounts independently and should not rely only on enquiries received.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Generate new enquiries and develop new accounts through direct customer visits, references, tender portals such as GeM and CPPP, and industry networks.
* Target segments include city gas distribution companies, compressed biogas and LNG project developers, EPC contractors, and industrial gas users.
* Build and maintain a sales pipeline sufficient to meet annual order booking targets and update it in the CRM.
* Prepare techno\-commercial offers with datasheets, deviation statements, and priced bills of quantity in coordination with engineering and production teams.
* Ensure compliance with PNGRB, OISD, BIS, ASME, and hazardous\-area requirements.
* Submit bids accurately and on time, follow up on offers, handle technical and commercial queries, negotiate, and close orders.
* Act as the principal customer contact until order placement, including presentations, plant visits, and commercial discussions.
* Support collections and after\-sales activities.
* Develop repeat business from the installed base through odorant, spares, and service contracts.
* Track competitor activity, pricing trends, and upcoming CGD and CBG projects.
* Represent the organization at exhibitions and industry forums.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

* B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.
* 5–8 years of experience in the sale of engineered\-to\-order equipment.
* Experience with odorisation systems, DRS, MRS or CGS skids, metering skids, or pressure vessels is preferred.
* Proven experience in direct sales to end customers and closing orders against targets.
* Working knowledge of public and private sector tendering, including GeM and e\-procurement portals.
* Ability to independently read P\&IDs, drawings, and datasheets.
* Ability to conduct technical discussions with customer engineers without support.
* Good understanding of costing, margins, payment terms, and contract conditions such as liquidated damages, bank guarantees, and price variation.
* Self\-driven and persistent through long sales cycles.
* Willingness to travel extensively across India.
* Fluent in English and Hindi.
* Mature and confident enough to represent the organization independently before senior customer personnel.
* Comfortable working with MS Office, CRM, and ERP systems.

INDUSTRY / PRODUCT EXPOSURE

Experience in any of the following areas will be preferred:

* Gas Odorisation Systems
* CGS / DRS / MRS Skids
* Gas Metering Skids
* Pressure Vessels
* Natural Gas Industry
* City Gas Distribution (CGD)
* Compressed Biogas (CBG)
* LNG Projects
* EPC Projects
* Industrial Gas Solutions

CAREER OPPORTUNITY

The position offers exposure to the Indian gas industry, engineered equipment sales, major CGD customers, EPC projects, and opportunities to develop into a regional or national sales leadership role.

title: Senior Enterprise Business Development Manager - APAC
description:
**About Innovatrics**


Innovatrics is a global provider of biometric identity management solutions, delivering fingerprint, face, iris, and multimodal biometric technologies to government and enterprise customers worldwide. The company operates independently with a strong R\&D foundation and a reputation for high NIST\-ranked performance and scalable identity platforms.

**Your Role**


As a Senior Enterprise Business Development Manager for APAC, you will be responsible for building Innovatrics’ enterprise footprint across the region from the ground up.


Unlike mature markets, APAC represents a high\-potential, underpenetrated territory where brand awareness and customer references are still limited. This role is focused on proactive market creation, new logo acquisition, and strategic expansion across key enterprise verticals including financial services, fintech platforms, telecom operators, digital marketplaces, and OEMs.


You will act as a market builder — identifying opportunities, structuring entry strategies, and converting early wins into long\-term regional growth engines.


In a nutshell, you will have to:

* Drive aggressive new business acquisition across APAC.
* Establish anchor enterprise references in priority countries.
* Build structured pipeline from outbound prospecting and ecosystem leverage.
* Develop positioning for identity verification, fraud prevention, and biometric onboarding use cases.
* Develop the region into a scalable revenue contributor over 3–5 years.

  

This is a high\-impact, high\-ownership hunter role — not an account maintenance position.

**Geographic Scope**

* APAC


Travel: 40–60% depending on active programs.

 **Why This Job Is Exciting**


This is a strategic expansion role with full ownership of Innovatrics’ enterprise growth across APAC.


You will lead market creation in a region where digital identity, onboarding, and fraud prevention are accelerating — yet where we are still building our footprint.


Success in this role means transforming a greenfield opportunity into a structured, reference\-backed regional business — with strong executive exposure and long\-term scaling potential.

 **Within one month, you will:**

* Get fully on\-boarded with our Enterprise solutions, platforms, and key tools
* Start building relationships with internal teams—Sales, Solutions, Engineering and Professional Services
* Learn our key customer use cases and industry challenges
* Learn our CRM (Zoho), automation tools, and account segmentation model
* Shadow sales calls and client meetings to understand our approach and customer profiles
* Take ownership of a portfolio of early\-stage enterprise accounts

 **Within three months, you will:**

* Complete a structured market assessment across priority countries (South\-East Asia).
* Define country prioritization and vertical focus (banks, fintech, telcos, digital platforms).
* Map top 30–50 target enterprise accounts.
* Initiate outbound engagement with decision\-makers.
* Align internally with Presales and Product on competitive positioning for LATAM.
* Deliver a 12\-month regional action plan.

 **Within six months, you will:**

* Build a qualified pipeline with clear revenue visibility.
* Conduct executive\-level meetings with key target accounts.
* Advance at least one lighthouse opportunity to late\-stage negotiation.
* Formalize at least one regional ecosystem partnership (SI, fintech integrator, or technology ally).
* Adapt messaging to regional regulatory and fraud landscape specifics.
* Deliver reliable forecast visibility to leadership.

 **Within one year, you will:**

* Secure at least one anchor enterprise customer and build a multi\-quarter pipeline with 3x coverage.
* Establish at least one referenceable customer.
* Demonstrate repeatable outbound motion across at least two priority countries.
* Create structured local case narratives for marketing leverage.
* Build a sustainable pipeline with multi\-quarter coverage.

**About You**


You have repeatedly built enterprise markets from limited brand presence to structured revenue engines. You thrive in greenfield territories where brand awareness is still being built and where success depends on initiative, structure, and persistence.


You understand how to engage C\-level executives, navigate complex enterprise decision cycles, and position high\-impact digital solutions in a way that resonates with business, risk, and technology stakeholders alike.


You are proactive and self\-driven. You do not wait for inbound leads — you create opportunities. You are comfortable building pipeline from scratch, qualifying rigorously, and focusing energy where probability of impact is highest.


You are comfortable competing against well\-established global and regional players and differentiating through technical performance and business value.


You combine strategic thinking with execution discipline. You can define a country entry strategy and, in the same week, lead a negotiation with a priority account.


You operate with autonomy, resilience, and accountability — and you are motivated by building something meaningful, not simply managing an existing book of business.

 **Requirements** **Qualifications**

* University degree in Technology, Engineering, or Business
* 10\+ years of enterprise sales experience in APAC.
* Proven hunter track record in new logo acquisition.
* Experience selling SaaS, identity verification, cybersecurity, or mission\-critical digital solutions.
* Existing network in Identity Industry is desired
* Strong understanding of APAC regulatory and compliance environments.
* Executive presence and negotiation maturity.
* Fluent in English.
* Comfortable working in hybrid/remote setups

  

**Benefits**  

  

Compensation
At Innovatrics, we offer highly competitive salaries because we value top talent focused on creating meaningful impact. Compensation is based on your experience, skills, qualifications, and location.


Compensation will be determined based on your expertise and the value you bring to our network.


This is a high\-impact, high\-ownership role combining market development, partner acquisition, and long\-term revenue growth.


Beyond base pay, we provide an attractive benefits package. You can learn more at https://careers.innovatrics.com/


**Interview Process**
Here is the typical interview process for this role:


Recruiter Screen (30 min)


Hiring Manager Interview (45 min)


Team Interview: Practical Business Case focused on Account Acquisition (60 min)


CARES (30 min)


Reference checks and offer discussion


We encourage candidates to request additional conversations with anyone they would like to meet.

title: Business Development Executive (SaaS Product)
description:
We are looking for a **B2B SaaS Sales Specialist** to join Catafy and drive customer acquisition, product demos, conversions, and onboarding.

The ideal candidate is confident in speaking with business owners and decision\-makers, understands SaaS products, and can clearly demonstrate how Catafy can help businesses manage and grow their digital product catalogs.

You will be responsible for managing prospects throughout the sales journey — from **lead generation and qualification to product demos, closing deals, and onboarding new customers**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Generate and qualify B2B leads through outbound calls, WhatsApp, email, social media, and other sales channels.
* Understand prospects' business requirements and identify how Catafy can solve their challenges.
* Conduct engaging **online product demos and walkthroughs** for prospective customers.
* Clearly explain Catafy's features, benefits, pricing, and use cases to business owners and decision\-makers.
* Follow up with prospects consistently and move qualified leads through the sales pipeline.
* Negotiate and close deals while achieving monthly and quarterly sales targets.
* Onboard new customers and help them successfully set up and start using Catafy.
* Build strong relationships with customers to encourage product adoption, retention, and referrals.
* Identify upselling and cross\-selling opportunities where appropriate.
* Maintain accurate lead, follow\-up, and sales activity records in the CRM.
* Work closely with the Product, Customer Success, and Marketing teams to improve the overall customer experience.
* Share customer feedback and market insights with internal teams to help improve the product and sales process.

**Required Experience**

* Minimum **1 year of experience in B2B sales**, preferably in SaaS, software, technology, or digital products.
* Proven ability to meet or exceed sales targets.
* Hands\-on experience conducting **online product demos and sales presentations**.
* Experience in customer onboarding and helping clients adopt software products.
* Experience selling to **business owners, founders, managers, or other decision\-makers** is preferred.
* Experience with CRM tools and sales pipelines is a plus.

**Required Skills**

* Strong **B2B sales and lead\-generation skills**.
* Excellent ability to conduct product demos and communicate product value.
* Strong objection\-handling, negotiation, follow\-up, and closing skills.
* Confidence in making **outbound sales calls** and communicating with prospects.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Strong presentation skills with the ability to explain software features in a simple, non\-technical manner.
* Comfortable using WhatsApp, email, video calls, CRM tools, and other digital sales platforms.
* Strong customer relationship and account\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently while consistently achieving sales goals.

**Communication Skills**

* Excellent **verbal and written English communication skills**.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline required.
* MBA in Sales, Marketing, or Business Management is a plus
* Ability to communicate confidently and professionally with business owners and decision\-makers.
* Hindi communication skills will be an advantage.
